name: spatial_dense_reach_level2_25d
description: spatial_dense_reach_level2_25d is a robotics benchmark measuring a controller or policy's ability to plan and execute dense reaching motions in a spatial environment with contact-aware constraints. It contains tasks requiring precise end-effector positioning and contact handling across varied initial conditions in a 25-dimensional state representation. The benchmark stresses robustness to contact interactions and fine motor control.
reputation: A specialized research dataset used in contact-aware robotics papers; moderate visibility within the robotics control research community.
